thread:
Maya: heads-up — final draft of the internal blurb for tomorrow's rollout is ready, need quick eyes and a pin owner. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Sam: sending in 5, can we keep the copy under 3 bullets? exec summary + fallback.
Priya: i can own the pin (model and api version). will pin to model@v2.8.1 and api route /gen-v2.
Oliver: thanks — can you confirm rollback criteria? happy to be on standby for rollbacks.
Priya: rollback if latency > 250ms p95 for 10m OR error rate > 1% for 5m. plan is to roll back to model@v2.8.0 and toggle routing.
Maya: perfect. Sam — paste the short blurb here and i'll edit. include the canary fraction and contact list.
Sam: draft: • Deploying inference slate 2026-03-21 (02:00-04:00 UTC). • Canary 10% for 20m then ramp to 100% if no regressions. • Pin: model@v2.8.1 on /gen-v2. Contact: @Priya (pin), @Oliver (rollback), @Jen (oncall).
Jen: oncall — i'll be monitoring traces and infra alerts during the window. set me as escalation.
DeployBot: [deploy-schedule] requested by Sam
```
/deploy schedule --release slate-2026-03-21 --route /gen-v2 --model model@v2.8.1 --canary 10% --canary-duration 20m --window 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z/2026-03-21T04:00:00Z
```
DeployBot: schedule accepted — deploy id 20260321-slate-07 queued. automated smokechecks enabled.
Priya: quick note — we'll enable prefix KV cache warmup 10m before window to avoid cold-start spikes. ops runbook updated.
Oliver: for rollback steps: 1) run /deploy rollback --id 20260321-slate-07 --target model@v2.8.0 2) disable canary route 3) notify customers + comms team. i'll draft the quick slack template.
Maya: good. can we add a fallback model policy in the release note? small sentence only.
Sam: added: "Fallback: automatic routing to model@v2.8.0 if smokechecks fail or latency thresholds breached."
Jen: are we publishing a pre-announce to the larger eng channel? might be useful to mention transient errors during the window.
Maya: yes — i'll post a concise heads-up 30m before start. Jen, ping me if alerts look noisy, we'll abort.
Priya: last ask — please confirm metrics ownership (latency/error dashboards). Sam/Oliver can you own the live dashboard during ramp?
Sam: can take latency dashboard. Oliver takes error/trace.
Maya: OK going to lock copy. final blurb below, ready for internal announce: 
"Deploying inference slate 2026-03-21 (02:00-04:00 UTC). Canary 10% for 20m then ramp to 100% if no regressions. Pin: model@v2.8.1 on /gen-v2. Fallback: automatic routing to model@v2.8.0 on failure. Contact: Priya (pin), Oliver (rollback), Jen (oncall)."
Oliver: looks good :thumbsup:
Jen: ready. i'll stand by.
Maya: thanks everyone — i'm posting to #general and pinning this thread to the release doc.
Sam: leaving the deploybot cue here so ops log is clean:
DeployBot: [deploy] 20260321-slate-07 — scheduled by Sam for 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z.
